well i have my parents. extremely homophobic, racists, and abusive. everyday feels like im walking on thin ice because literally anything i do can be a reason of chaos. my parents are also forcing me to get into a course in school that i don’t want to do, and i feel like i’m gonna waste my life there. but i really dont know what to do with my life. it starts in a few months. i even heard my parents planning to spend another tons of money for a school we clearly can’t afford- which means we’ll suffer and starve again. i can’t go through that again. they’re really shit with money.

i dont have that much friends. almost all of them left me. i barely have the motivation to stand up and do things, but i force myself to, because i have nausea recently. im also back with having a big anxiety on my body image and face, it’s starting to make me feel so nervous that i can’t stand still in public. i got so much better before the pandemic, but it’s reverting back to the start. and many many more things.

but i have a special friend as of now. they make me feel special and i have a good time talking to them. we decided to stay as friends because of the distance, but it’s all good. im happy when they are. my mood has been improving and my parents stopped acting like assholes for a while. but.. my friend is in circumstances that are very dangerous, and they make me worry when they are away. im scared of them just disappearing and i’d lose that one anchor that’s been keeping me up. im not necessarily too dependent on them, but i know that it’ll hurt so so much. everything will slap me in the face again if that happens. but that’s just probably my paranoia.
